scenicChapters.title: German Alpine Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 80 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

munich-bavarian-alps-ammergau-and-planse.story: 514 km one way from Bad Aibling - plan on about 9 h 24 of riding. The stops in between: Scenic stretch in Peißenberg, near Dinkelscherben and near Schierling. near Kochel is the high point. It tops out at about 1,300 m.
